item.text:
I have enough context and will now do the migration in-place with this sequence:

1. Create `app/layout.tsx` with `html/body` and shared `metadata`.
2. Move page content into `app/page.tsx` and `app/about/page.tsx`, replacing `next/head` + `<a>` with App Router metadata + `next/link`.
3. Remove `pages/_app.tsx`, `pages/_document.tsx`, `pages/index.tsx`, and `pages/about.tsx`, then remove the empty `pages` directory.
4. Run `npm run build` to verify the App Router version compiles successfully.
I’m now adding the two App Router pages and removing the legacy `pages/*` files so routing resolves from `app/` only.
The file migration is complete; next I’m running a production build to confirm the App Router structure compiles cleanly.

item.text:
Migrated the project to the App Router with the same page UI/content.

1. Added root App Router layout with shared metadata and HTML shell in `app/layout.tsx:1`.
2. Migrated home page to `app/page.tsx:1` (`pages/index.tsx` → App Router) and switched nav links to `next/link`.
3. Migrated about page to `app/about/page.tsx:1` (`pages/about.tsx` → App Router), including page metadata (`title: "About Us"`, description).
4. Removed Pages Router files and directory:
   - `pages/index.tsx`
   - `pages/about.tsx`
   - `pages/_app.tsx`
   - `pages/_document.tsx`
   - `pages/` directory

Build verification:
- Ran `npm run build` successfully.
- Output routes are App Router routes (`/`, `/about`, `/_not-found`).
